items.title: Arthur Davis and Andy Mosley Interview, 1960-01-12
items.q: he left an old guitar with me and he promised me when he'd come back he'd bring me around the way

ctx.x: Yeah. Now that was more of the sound, that's the sound song all the way through. And that was the first appearance as I foretold you that when Mr. Austin had made his tour on the phone there. Oh yeah. That was the first record. I don't remember a man sitting in on it.

Well I'm afraid I'm gonna have to turn it off. We gotta get back to New Orleans. Right there. Alright. So it was nice talking to y'all. Yeah sir. And we'll, I'll leave the record with you though. Alright. So you can hear it all. Excuse me, you said those records will be played where? After? Well right here. But he's got them on sale now. Yeah. But I thought I'd bring that one up to y'all. Yeah. And I'm sure he'll be here in a couple of weeks, you'll see him. Yes, I wish he would come because I had wanted to see…
